package.name: kdl_msgs
package.description: ROS 2 port of the Orocos kdl_msgs package: ROS messages which can be used in place of Orocos KDL types. Faithful port of orocos/kdl_msgs with changes forced by ROS 2 rosidl: field renames Frame.M -> Frame.m and RigidBodyInertia.I -> .i (uppercase field names are not allowed); the Joint, Segment and Chain messages are omitted because their mixed-case constants (RotAxis, None_, ...) are illegal ROS 2 constant names and they are unused by sweetie_bot. Add them back with UPPER_CASE constants if kinematic-structure messages are needed.
